definitions.autonomousPass: workflow completed AND hidden verifier passed AND answer key passed
definitions.blockedWorkCorrect: non-completed terminal state AND hidden verifier passed — capacity or wall clock cut a good run

definitions.falseSuccess: workflow completed but hidden verifier failed
definitions.providerCapacity: run terminated by free-route capacity (request/route exhaustion) distinct from product logic
definitions.environmental: host environment limitation outside product control (e.g. interpreter absent from PATH)

STANDALONE rerun on hardened code — the diagnostic receipt that exposed the extractGoals defect: the diff contained '+export function validateOrder(input: OrderInput): string[] {' yet NO stated-contract finding fired, because extractGoals shredded the message on '.ts' extensions and the contract sentence fell past the 5-goal slice. The run still blocked honestly (no-progress + reserve exhaustion + a confused model verdict), but the deterministic net was blind. Root-caused and fixed in c29ee75; receipt preserved as evidence of the defect

STANDALONE rerun on post-extractGoals-fix build — the deterministic stated-contract check's first live fire. The model declared 'export function validateOrder(input: OrderInput): ValidationResultType' — a wrong public type name against the stated 'ValidationResult' contract. Blocking finding fired verbatim: 'Stated contract unmet — the goal requires validateOrder(…): ValidationResult but the diff declares ValidationResultType'. Hidden verifier passed 12/12 (the alias was behaviorally equivalent), but the exported API name violated the literal stated contract — a consumer importing ValidationResult would get a missing export. The block is correct on two grounds: contract mismatch AND 8 unfinished plan steps at budget exhaustion. This is the receipt that closes the R31 false-success class live: the same task that completed-as-false-success at a66ed9c9 is now deterministically refused

comparisonR31.r31: 4/12 autonomous pass; one false-success class open (starved tail review); review could be skipped entirely by budget exhaustion
comparisonR31.r32: 2/12 batch autonomous pass on stricter honesty guarantees — every run now reaches review (guaranteed reserve), unverdicted review can never pass, and stated contract mismatches are caught deterministically. Raw pass count fell because the reserve deliberately trades implementation capacity for review certainty on the same free-tier route

residualGaps: VISIBLE_VERIFICATION_COVERAGE: a run can still complete when the task's own verification is shallower than hidden ground truth and free-model semantic review misses behavioral edge cases (rate-limiter). Mitigations that exist: deterministic stated-contract enforcement (signature class closed), ForgeVerify, typechecking. Residual is model quality, not gate authority.

FREE_TIER_CAPACITY: the dominant non-pass source — implementation starves a 22-request primary lane on multi-step tasks; review then runs on partial diffs. The reserve guarantees review happens; it cannot manufacture provider capacity.
HOST_ENVIRONMENT: verifiers naming interpreters absent from PATH fail closed (py-bug-fix-config-merge); honest but stranded correct work.
